visibility: evaluator-only; never copy into generation workspaces or prompts

dimensions.guidanceDiscovery: Inspect tool trace for reading the installed compact entry and focused task guidance; absent trace is unknown, not a failure.
dimensions.patternSelection: Independent reviewer checks selected pattern against task and explains any inappropriate alternative.
dimensions.taskOutcome: Settings: saved API record equals entered values and reload shows them. Collection: search narrows actual service results and reset restores all.
dimensions.applicableStates: Record individual applicable states, omitted states and non-applicable states, not a universal checklist denominator.
dimensions.retainedInput: Reject a save and verify exact draft persists; successful retry stores that draft.
dimensions.recovery: Reject first save/load and allow second; useful actionable error and real recovery must occur.
dimensions.adverseStates: Settings: invalid submission, unsaved edits on leave (keep, then discard). Records: out-of-order query responses, first-use empty.
dimensions.followupFeatures: Final stage only. Settings: the description is saved and shown on the overview after reload. Records: name sort in both directions and a selection count that matches the selected rows.
dimensions.keyboardPassed: True only when tab order, activation, linked errors, reachable retry and focus on view changes all pass; record defects with severity and evidence.
dimensions.axeScanPassed: True only when axe reports no violations in every scanned state (initial, invalid, failed, saved, dirty-leave, no-results, first-use-empty, failed-refresh). Incomplete axe results are listed per state for manual review. Manual screen-reader findings are separate. No conformance claim.
dimensions.contentAccuracy: Independent reviewer checks consequence, error and success copy against actual outcome; report misleading claims.
dimensions.responsive: 320px viewport, long localized strings and RTL; check clipping and operability. Test forced colors/reduced motion where applicable.
dimensions.followupPreserved: True only when every check that passed before the follow-up edit still passes after it; a fresh process reads the existing generated artifact without evaluator feedback.
dimensions.complexity: Report source lines, new dependencies, custom interaction logic and reviewer notes. Smaller is not automatically better.
dimensions.developmentCost: Report elapsed time, enforced wall-time budget, exit reason, token usage where supplied, model/tool versions and monetary cost only when reported.

review: Keep raw per-state results and evidence paths. Null means unmeasured. Independent review and representative user studies are required before human effectiveness claims. Pilot estimates refine the protocol, not release effectiveness targets.
